source_name: bankweb.hu – IIR Magyarország Kártyapiac konferencia coverage
why_relevant: Secondary HU banking portal that reproduces card-market conference agendas and speaker lists; a useful fallback when the IIR legacy site's archive pages are unreachable, and an independent record of which vendors and banks presented.
Regular bank-authored publication; useful as a low-noise recurring feed and occasionally frames sector technology/regulatory shifts from the bank's own view.
Financial comparison/news site that republishes and expands on bank digitalisation and ATM-regulation stories; useful as a redundancy layer for capturing items missed on the primary outlets.

source_name: Commercial TED/EU tender aggregators (TendersOnTime, GlobalTenders, Apify TED scraper)
why_relevant: Secondary aggregators that sometimes surface IFI and non-TED notices in a searchable form and can act as a discovery shortcut. Low credibility as a primary record — always resolve back to the official notice before using a fact.

source_name: Céginformáció.hu – cégkereső és hiteles cégkivonat szolgáltató
why_relevant: One of the licensed commercial distributors of the official register; alternative access channel for cégkivonat when the state portal is inconvenient, and a searchable index of HU entities.
Commercial reseller of the official e-cégjegyzék extract; a practical fallback channel when the state portal's authentication flow is impractical for a foreign analyst without Hungarian e-ID.

source_name: EU Open Data Portal — TED dataset (data.europa.eu)
why_relevant: Curated CSV/XML redistributions of TED with long historical coverage, easier to load into analysis than raw notice XML. Useful as a cross-check and for quick country+CPV aggregate counts.

source_name: Euronet Magyarország (Euronet EFT) – independent ATM estate operator
why_relevant: Largest independent ATM deployer in Hungary and a processing/cash-network operator; both a buyer of ATM hardware/software and a competitor to bank-outsourced ATM management. Its site documents network scale and services.

entity_name: Hungarian grant-consultancy and pályázat trade press
source_name: Hungarian grant-consultancy and pályázat trade press (pafi.hu, palyaz.hu, dft.hu, nphprojekt.hu, palyazatnet.hu, bkik.hu)
why_relevant: Consultancies republish draft and final call texts, product sheets and eligibility analyses faster and more legibly than the official portal, and often host felhívás PDF versions that later disappear. Good early-warning layer for new digitalisation calls; must be treated as secondary and validated against palyazat.gov.hu.

source_name: Hungarian plastic-card production bureaus (Coimbra Kft., Draftpress Kft., Plasztikgyár)
why_relevant: Second-tier domestic card producers. Mostly loyalty/access cards rather than EMV bank cards, but they define the local competitive floor and occasionally serve bank-adjacent programmes; useful for distinguishing scheme-certified personalisation (ANY/Thales/IDEMIA class) from general plastic-card printing.
Aggregator with per-company Budapest pages (e.g. GIRO Zrt.), convenient for building a per-employer hiring time series for the small set of HU payment infrastructure firms.

Example of the Hungarian-language 'esettanulmányok' pattern used by local IT suppliers to name their financial-sector reference clients. Establishes the local search idiom (esettanulmány / referenciák / ügyfeleink) that should be applied across every HU vendor and integrator site.

source_name: Shopify App Store — SimplePay (by OTP Mobil) listing
why_relevant: Marketplace listings expose distribution strategy, supported markets, install/review counts and release notes for HU PSPs — an indirect quantitative proxy for merchant adoption that vendors do not publish.

entity_name: SIX Payment Services Hungary legacy site
source_name: SIX Payment Services Hungary legacy site
why_relevant: Legacy HU domain still serving product pages for the Worldline/SIX acquiring business; useful for historical baseline of terminal and acceptance product lines and for detecting migration/rebranding events.

Secondary alerting layer over the same statutory notices. Value is redundancy and early notification rather than unique content; also a pointer to which sectors/keywords the local market itself treats as one category.
